description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing message-related operations such as fetching messages, toggling read status, and removing messages in a React-Redux application.

methods.name: fetchMessages
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that fetches messages from the API and dispatches relevant actions to update the Redux store.

methods.name: fetchMessagesStatus
methods.description: Action creator that returns an action to update the message fetch status in the store.

methods.name: messageToggle
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that toggles the read status of a message by ID.

methods.name: messageRemove
methods.description: Asynchronous action creator that removes a message by ID.
